name: Tomato-Spinach Orzo with Veggie Ground & Parsley
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallots.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot, veggie ground, and spices; cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

Add broth, tomato sauce, and orzo to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed and orzo is desired firmness, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
When the orzo is done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add nutritional yeast and half of the parsley to the skillet, then stir to combine. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide orzo between plates or bowls; top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
